stem.text: A parallel beam of monochromatic light of wavelength $\lambda$ is incident normally on a diffraction grating G. The angle between the directions of the two second-order diffracted beams at $\text{P}_1$ and at $\text{P}_2$ is $\alpha$, as shown.

stem.alt: Light travelling horizontally into a grating G; two second-order diffracted beams labelled P1 and P2 leave the grating upwards and downwards, with the angle alpha marked between them.
